second_order.thesis: Rising crude and a weak rupee lift the rupee realisation of an oil producer (ONGC) and squeeze the marketing margin of a refiner-marketer that cannot pass pump prices through quickly (HPCL). Long the winner, paper-short the loser.
second_order.label: ONGC vs HINDPETRO
second_order.event: Crude price rise plus rupee weakness through September-October 2026 (analyst commentary, 3-15 Oct 2026); not a single-day event, so the rule is time-boxed
second_order.post_event_rule: close both legs at the next open after 2026-12-15; close earlier if Brent falls back to its 15 Oct 2026 level for five consecutive sessions, or if HPCL wins back half of its underperformance versus ONGC since entry (the market has rejected the link)
second_order.post_event_applied: 2026-11-06 rule triggered (Brent 15 Oct close 105.92; 2-6 Nov closes 104.77, 103.60, 94.62, 98.29, 98.69, all below); SELL ONGC + COVER HINDPETRO queued for the next open
second_order.invalidation: Government cuts excise duty or allows pump price hikes that restore HPCL's marketing margin; or a windfall tax on upstream producers removes ONGC's benefit from higher crude
